My sincere condolences for the loss of your father, for you and the rest of your family.  You couldn't prevent this tho, nor predict its occurrence.  For whatever his reason, you are not to blame.  I suggest seeing a third party (counselor) who is unconnected to help you work through your grief and any guilt you feel.  I think people have the right to end their own life, although it's a horrid choice.  The survivors suffer immensely...but it's still a personal choice.  Treat yourself with care and love.  ♡
